item.description: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued delivering UAV strikes against Ukraine's data centres, port infrastructure and vessels involved in the delivery of military cargo to Ukraine. 💥 As a result of the strikes, in Kiev, the ATM Ukrsibbank data processing centre used by the AFU to collect, process, and store reconnaissance information was hit. 💥 In addition, a dry cargo ship was hit at sea; it had been delivering cargo to the port of Odessa to support the AFU. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29956

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 10 October 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see Part 1
)
💥
The Tsentr Group's units inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and two national guard brigades near Starorayskoye, Roganskoye, Belozerskoye, Sergeyevka, and Veselaya Gora (Donetsk People's Republic).
▫️
In Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), the 51st Army's assault groups have advanced in the central and northern-western parts of the city. Marine units continued the offensive in the western part of the city and continued to destroy the enemy on the territory of the Dobropolskaya mining plant. Two enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement were thwarted.
🔥
Over the past 24 hours, 82 buildings, including four workshops, have been liberated, more than 35 troops and two armoured fighting vehicles have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, Ukrainian armed formations sustained losses of up to 525 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, five artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence.
They inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of one air assault brigade, three assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade close to Ivanovka, Pokrovskoye (Dnepropetrovsk region), Nikolskoye, Nikolay-Pole, Volnyanka, and Zalivnoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 275 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and seven motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted fire damage on two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Preobrazhenka and Kushugum (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 15 troops, 12 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns have been neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage on
power industry facilities used in the interests of Ukraine's defence industry enterprises, production workshops of UAVs and their depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed groups and foreign mercenaries in 151 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
two U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles and 725 fixed-wing UAVs.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
258,265
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,183
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,786
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,686
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
74,141
special military vehicles
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29955

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
▫️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to tighten the encirclement and expand the external control zone.
🚩
In the encirclement, as a result of active combat operations, the settlements of Lukashovo and Lobanovka (Kharkov region) have been brought under control.
🔥
Battles are underway for the liberation of
Nikolayevka, Varvarovka, Reznikovo, Nefedovka and Chernoye (Kharkov region).
▪️
Over the past 24 hours, the enemy lost up to 45 troops and three ground robotic systems in the encirclement.
💥
While extending the external control zone, there is active fighting for the settlements of Prikolotnoye and Kotovka (Kharkov region).
🔥
In addition,
in Kharkov region,
Russian troops
hit
manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, two motorised infantry brigades, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one national guard brigade near Slatino, Berezovka, Zamulovka, Martovoye, Vodyanoye, Tsirkuny, Cherkasskaya Lozovaya, and Russkaya Lozovaya.
📍
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at
formations of three mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Studenok, Ivolzhanskoye, Yastrebinoye, Topolya, Stetskovka, and Osoyevka.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost up to 270 troops, 11 motor vehicles, and one Akatsiya self-propelled artillery system in the Sever Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Zapad Group's units improved the situation along the front line and inflicted losses on
the manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Glubokaya Makatikha, Yatskovka, and Karpovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 220 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 13 motor vehicles, three artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted fire damage on formations of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade, one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one territorial defence brigades near Krasny Molochar, Kramatorsk, Belenkoye, Slavyansk, and Semenovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 150 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 28 motor vehicles, and five field artillery guns.
👉
See Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
